protocol.name: v1
protocol.description: MythicBench v1. Five agents (copies of one model, one per character) play a 5-person party through the Hollow Vault, blind, learning over up to 5 pulls per episode. Ranked on +10 only, 6 episodes per model on a fresh seed schedule. Memory-off controls for the two cheap models (12 paired episodes each), Normal as an unranked sanity check, and low/high effort sweeps for cost curves.
